Spearing ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0001-5459-5909 1 & … Nazanin Tajik 8 Show authors Nature Water volume 4 , pages 1062–1067 ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research 139 Accesses Metrics details Addressing ageing water infrastructure requires more than engineering solutions. We must also plan for the evolving demographic realities of the populations these systems serve. Here we introduce the infrastructure–society ageing gap (ISAG) as a framework for incorporating demographic ageing into water infrastructure decision-making throughout the infrastructure life cycle.
